newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH 1996 YR/YR CPI SEEN AT 18.4-18.6 PCT.
newsitem.headline: POLISH 1996 YR/YR CPI SEEN AT 18.4-18.6 PCT.

text.p: Polish year-on-year consumer inflation in 1996 is estimated at between 18.4 and 18.6 percent against 21.6 percent in 1995, Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said on Monday.
"I believe that (year-on-year) inflation in 1996 will be 18.4 percent, but I will not dispair if it turns out to be 18.6 percent," Kolodko told reporters.

The government initially aimed at bringing inflation down to 17 percent in year-on-year terms in December 1996 and wants to reduce it to 13 percent in December 1997, which many economists see as a very ambitious task.
